subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The live_preview block is added with `management_token: ""` (an empty literal) and the prescribed `CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN` was never added to the env destructuring block (lines 23-36). Note: I verified against the installed contentstack SDK's index.d.ts (line 123: `live_preview: { enable: boolean, host: string, management_token: string }`), so deviating from the plan's `preview_token` key is correct — the installed SDK does not declare it. However, with an empty management_token and no preview token wired from env, server-side draft retrieval through this Stack has no credential to authorize draft access, putting AC 1/2/5 (draft content shown instead of published) at risk for any fetch that does not go through the live-preview-utils URL-hash injection.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN = ""` to the env destructuring (lines 23-36) and use it: `management_token: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN` (or wire the preview token the SDK expects). Do not leave a hardcoded empty token.

issues.description: `live_preview: { enable: true, ... }` is now unconditionally enabled on the shared `Stack` (line 91) that ALL server-side and client-side fetches flow through, including production traffic with no preview session. AC 3/4 require zero behavioral change when no preview signal is active; an always-on live_preview config risks altering request headers/params on every delivery request in production.
issues.suggestedFix: Gate enablement on the presence of the preview token or an explicit env flag, e.g. `enable: Boolean(CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN)`, so the non-preview path is byte-identical to current behavior.

issues.description: `setContent((prev) => ({ ...prev, page: [updatedPage as any] }))` uses an untyped `as any` with no explanatory comment, violating the TypeScript strict criterion. The sibling subscription in [[...slug]].tsx types the same value as IContentstackPage without a cast, so the cast appears unnecessary.
issues.suggestedFix: Drop the `as any` (the listener is already typed `(updatedPage: IContentstackPage) => void`), or if the 404 content type genuinely differs, add a comment explaining the cast.

issues.description: `stackSdk: Stack as any` has an eslint-disable but no explanation of why the cast is needed (the live-preview-utils IStackSdk type is structural and may accept the SDK Stack with a narrower assertion). An unexplained `as any` hides real type drift between the delivery SDK and live-preview-utils versions.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace with a documented, narrower cast (e.g. `as unknown as IStackSdk` imported from @contentstack/live-preview-utils) plus a one-line comment explaining the mismatch, or remove the cast if the types align.

issues.description: `host: CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST || "api.contentstack.io"` hardcodes the endpoint URL string. Per project convention, endpoint URLs should come from named constants.
issues.suggestedFix: Move the default host into a named constant (e.g. in constants/contentstack) and reference it here.
